fields.Name: IT138 - Chief of Staff Core Layers
fields.Description: Deterministic proof of the Chief of Staff's MJ-core layers, with no LLM calls and no Open App dependency: ownership guards on agent policies and agent requests, Run User Routine Now (refuses another user's routine, runs an owned one-shot without spending its schedule), the AgentUserPolicyEngine cache following an entity save, and Manage My Email Inbox and Drafts queueing a Send's approval before any mail provider is consulted while DraftOnly refuses it.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Non-Owner users cannot write another user's policy or request; run-now refuses foreign routines and keeps an owned one-shot's NextRunAt; a policy save updates the engine cache; a Send under SendAsUser with approval returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED and queues exactly one request carrying the draft; DraftOnly returns POLICY_DENIED and queues nothing.
